title: Lena Marsh
bio: Lena measures what other people only feel: layout shifts, long tasks and the half-second a page hesitates. She writes about making fast sites boring in the best way.

title: Tomás Ibarra
bio: Tomás has run small independent publications for twelve years and still prefers a plain text file to a dashboard. He writes about rhythm, audiences and sustainable editorial work.

title: Noor Haddad
bio: Noor designs reading experiences and tests them with a keyboard, a screen reader and a very bright window. She writes about type, contrast and the details that make a page feel considerate.
